description: This file is a shell script used for testing various aspects of Git repositories, including cloning, alternates, object management, symlinks, and garbage handling. It defines test functions and executes sequences of Git commands to validate repository behaviors during development and testing.

methods.name: commit_in
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified repository with a given filename and content.

methods.name: test_objcount
methods.description: Checks the number of loose objects in a specified repository.
